notes.title: IROTORIDORI NO SEKAI - THE COLORFUL WORLD RELEASE DATE AND GIVEAWAY!
notes.notes:

We are super excited for our first game developed by FAVORITE!
IROTORIDORI NO SEKAI - THE COLORFUL WORLD will be released on Friday the 16th of February!
Check out the store page and put it on your wishlist![/b]

[b]To celebrate the upcoming release of "Irotoridori no Sekai: The Colorful World", we're giving away Steam keys! 
Check out the giveaway here -> [url=https://twitter.com/NekoNyanSoft/status/1756907348512080239]https://twitter.com/NekoNyanSoft/status/1756907348512080239[/url]
